brief:
Settlers entered the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound and performed religious rituals at the site, the Ma'an news agency reported. The group carried out Talmudic prayers during the incursion into the mosque's premises in occupied East Jerusalem.

The Al-Aqsa compound remains a focal point of Israeli-Palestinian friction, with repeated entries by settlers and Israeli security forces occurring despite international concern. Palestinian authorities have consistently protested such visits as violations of the site's religious sanctity and agreements governing access to the holy location. The incident is part of a broader pattern of contested presence at the compound, which holds significance for both Muslim and Jewish communities.
title: Settlers storm Al-Aqsa mosque and perform Talmudic rites.
